title: One2Many: Elbit Systems’ FUSE Introduces Military-Grade Autonomous Systems Built for Scale
body_markdown:
- One2Many operational capabilities powered by a unified AI operating system enabling centralized coordination of autonomous swarms and distributed aerial and ground formations at scale.
- FUSE delivers mature military-grade autonomous systems designed for scalable and resilient multi-domain operations, supported by Elbit Systems’ operational experience and high-volume manufacturing infrastructure.
- FUSE's solutions have accumulated more than 1,000,000 operational flight hours and over 100,000 autonomous ground operation hours, with thousands of platforms delivered worldwide.


Rosh-HaAyin, Israel, September 9, 2026 – Elbit Systems Ltd.'s FUSE, today unveiled its AI-driven autonomous combat systems and One2Many operational capabilities, enabling centralized real-time coordination of large numbers of autonomous aerial and ground systems.


Built on years of operational experience, proven technologies and advanced autonomy developed within Elbit Systems, FUSE delivers mature military-grade autonomous systems designed for scalable coordinated operations across land and air domains.


At the core of the portfolio is Dominion-X, an AI-powered unified operating system enabling One2Many operations in GNSS-denied environments, supported by advanced automatic target recognition (ATR) and homing capabilities. Dominion-X enables centralized real-time coordination and management of autonomous aerial and ground systems, including real-time mission data exchange between platforms and distributed operations across battlefield environments through a shared mission network.


Designed for contested and GPS-denied environments, FUSE's solutions support resilient mission execution, distributed autonomous operations and manned-unmanned teaming (MUM-T) alongside maneuvering forces and crewed platforms within existing military formations and command structures.


FUSE's solutions also enable military forces to rapidly integrate autonomous capabilities into existing tactical assets, unmanned systems and combat vehicles, creating scalable coordinated autonomous formations while leveraging current force structures.


Supported by Elbit Systems’ operational experience, manufacturing infrastructure and global defense footprint, FUSE's solutions are designed for scalable production, rapid field integration and sustained operational deployment across multi-domain operations.


The technologies and autonomous systems within FUSE’s portfolio have already accumulated more than 1,000,000 operational flight hours and over 100,000 autonomous ground operation hours, with thousands of drones and hundreds of unmanned ground platforms already delivered to customers worldwide.


## **FUSE’s portfolio includes:**


- UNMANNED TACTICAL FORCE – a fully digitized Unmanned Tactical Force for recon-strike in mass operations.
- PIRANI-X – Seek and strike tactical swarm drone solutions for maneuvering forces.
- URBAN LETHALITY SYSTEMS - Stand-in mass UGV & one-way attack (OWA) drones designed for urban operations and engagements against indoor and fortified threats.
- ARMORED WINGMAN SYSTEMS – Ground and airborne unmanned assets working alongside, or deployed from, manned armored platforms.
- BORDER DEFENSE SYSTEMS - A combination of mobile, deployed and fixed unmanned ground and airborne assets performing autonomous border protection missions with minimal operator involvement across vast areas of interest.
- MULTI-MISSION GROUP 1 AND 2 UNCREWED AIRCRAFT SYSTEMS (UAS) – The X-intra, THOR and Magni-X families of backpack-portable, rapidly deployable, fully autonomous multi-rotor VTOL UAS designed to support a wide range of tactical missions such as reconnaissance, surveillance, target acquisition and identification, communications relay, electronic warfare support, resupply, limited cargo delivery and configurable mission effects.
- GROUND AUTONOMY KITS - AI-powered autonomous solutions (hardware & software) designed for multiple critical off-road missions in contested environments, including fully autonomous operations of UGVs and manned platforms, teleoperation capabilities and ADAS/EVPS (Enhanced Visual Position System).


FUSE's systems are already operationally deployed and in service with customers in Israel, the United States and Europe, supporting ongoing operational missions and force modernization programs.


Leveraging Elbit Systems’ battlefield integration experience and defense infrastructure, FUSE’s autonomous capabilities are designed to support real-world operational requirements, including high-tempo maneuver operations, distributed force deployment and multi-domain combat scenarios.


By integrating autonomous systems directly into frontline formations, FUSE helps military forces to increase operational tempo, expand combat mass, accelerate sensor-to-shooter cycles and improve force survivability while reducing risk to personnel.


"Military forces are entering a new operational era in which combat effectiveness will increasingly depend not only on autonomous platforms themselves, but on the ability to integrate and coordinate large numbers of autonomous systems within existing maneuver forces in real time," said **Eyal Dahan, CEO of FUSE.** "FUSE was established to deliver that capability today - combining autonomous platforms, operational AI and scalable One2Many command capabilities into integrated operational solutions that can be rapidly deployed and integrated into modern combat formations."


**About FUSE**


FUSE, operating as an integral part of Elbit Systems C4I & Cyber, specializes in design, development and delivery of world-leading AI-driven autonomous combat systems solutions, providing mission-critical unmanned capabilities at scale.
